description: Enterprise techniques used by BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR, ATT&CK software S9045 (v1.0)
name: BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR (S9045)

techniques.comment: [BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9045) has the ability to leverage `sudo` for executing commands.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Compromise)
[BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9045) has leveraged OpenAI’s GPT-4.1 API to analyze extracted data.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach)
[BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9045) can interact with and execute Docker and Kerberos commands.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Compromise)

[BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9045) has a module that gathered Cloud Secrets Management Stores from password vaults within Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Compromise)
[BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9045) has exfiltrated data using OpenAI’s GPT-4.1 API.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach)

[BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9045) has created a skills file titled `AI LATERAL_SUGGESTIONS.md` that included tables mapped with harvested credentials with potential victim internal servers.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach)
[BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9045) has enumerated the ports on victim systems within the victim environment.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach)
[BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9045) has the ability to identify NFS and SMB shares within the victim environment.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Compromise)
[BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9045) has the ability to enumerate the processes running within the victim environment.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach)
[BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9045) has connected to compromised servers within the victim environment via SOCKS proxies.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach)

[BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9045) has performed remote system discovery mapping harvested credentials to systems within the target environment.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach)
[BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9045) has the ability to abuse Sudo/Cron for privilege escalation.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Compromise)

[BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9045) has the ability to steal application tokens for CI/CD services to include Bamboo, Github, and Jenkins.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Compromise)
[BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9045) has discovered system configurations on victim devices.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach)
[BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9045) has gathered credentials stored in configuration files.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach)
[BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9045) has extracted system data to include histories.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach)

[BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9045) has a module that is capable of gathering Cloud Instance Metadata to include AWS, Google Cloud Platform, and Azure.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Compromise)
